name: Les Arcs
description: Les Arcs opened in 1968 as one of France's first designer ski resorts. 4 Arc villages (1600, 1800, 1950, 2000) plus Les Chapieux at different altitudes, car-free and ski-in/ski-out. Linked to La Plagne via the Vanoise Express to form Paradiski (425 km, 260 pistes). Home of the Aiguille Rouge (3,225 m) with 7 km black-to-red run, Apocalypse snowpark (one of Alps' best freestyle parks), and the Olympic KL Flying Kilometre speed-skiing piste. Night skiing on floodlit runs in Arc 1600 and 1800.

overview.atmosphere: Avant-garde design resort, 5 Arc villages linked to Paradiski (425 km). Aiguille Rouge zip-line, Igloo Village, Mille8 aquatic centre. Birthplace of Ski Evolutif, spiritual home of European snowboarding.

beyond_skiing.snowshoeing: Guided walks from Arc 1950 and Arc 2000
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Bowling at Arc 1800 and Arc 2000, open 5pm-2am

best_restaurants: Le 2134 (Arc 2000) — panoramic terrace, local produce, fine wine list
Le Chalet de Luigi (Arc 1950) — Italian cuisine, 400 m² sunny terrace
Le Chalet de l'Isère (Arc 1800) — traditional mountain

apres_and_nightlife.nightlife_clubbing: Le Geneux (Arc 1600), Le J.O. Live Stage Bar (Arc 1800), The Wool Socks Pub (Arc 1950), O'Chaud (Arc 1950), Le 2134 (Arc 2000), Bulle Café (Arc 2000). Le Carré Nightclub (Arc 1800)

villages.name: Arc 1600 (Pierre Blanche)
villages.character: Original 1968 village, 20th-Century Heritage Site, intimate, family-friendly, quiet, 7 min funicular from Bourg-St-Maurice station

villages.name: Arc 1800
villages.character: Largest and liveliest, 4 sub-villages (Charvet, Villards, Chantel, Charmettoger), best apres, Mille8 aquatic centre, bowling, golf course, Le Carré nightclub

villages.name: Arc 1950 (Le Village)
villages.character: Intrawest-built North American Alpine style, car-free, family zone, Deep Nature Spa, Mongolian yurt dining experience, Wool Socks Pub

villages.name: Arc 2000
villages.character: Highest Arc village, direct Aiguille Rouge access, light-up murals, bowling, Le 2134 panoramic restaurant, quiet evenings

villages.name: Les Chapieux
villages.character: The wild one — quietest and most remote Arc village

honest_drawbacks: Some lift queues at peak times
Car-free means parking at valley entrance, shuttle required
